```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# load packages
library(easystats)
library(conflicted)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(bayestestR)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(DHARMa)
library(tictoc)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(mice)
library(marginaleffects)
library(priorsense)
library(posterior)
library(loo)
library(shinystan)
library(shinybrms)
library(ggdist)
library(brmsmargins)
library(viridis)
library(ggnewscale)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpmisc)
library(gginnards)
library(ggridges)
library(ggpubr)

# set package parameters
theme_set(theme_bw())

n_cores <- max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 4)
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = n_cores)

options(marginaleffects_parallel_inferences = TRUE)
options(marginaleffects_parallel = TRUE)
options(marginaleffects_parallel_packages = c("marginaleffects", "brms"))
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "eti")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)

bayesplot::bayesplot_theme_set(bayesplot::theme_default(base_family = "serif", base_size = 16))

set.seed(808)

```

```{r}
subjData$SNRlevel <- factor(subjData$SNRlevel, levels=SNRCatsA, order=TRUE)

# reorder by participant ID and trial number
```

## filter and impute missing age data

```{R}

# filter data to exclude the missing age participant and the missing response data
subjDataNoAmb.cc <- subjDataNoAmb |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(TrialNumber))

# first create a participant-level dataset
subj_dat <- subjData |> dplyr::select(ID, Age) |> dplyr::distinct()

# create a median imputation for missing age data
subj_dat.med <- subj_dat |> dplyr::mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age),
                                                   median(Age, na.rm=TRUE),
                                                   Age))

# now merge the imputed age data back into the main dataset
subjData.med <- subjData |> dplyr::select(-Age) |> dplyr::left_join(subj_dat.med, by="ID")

# now filter the dataset to exclude ambient-only stimuli
subjDataNoAmb.med <- subjData.med |> dplyr::filter(UASLAeq != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels()

# use multiple imputation to impute missing age data
imp_data <- mice::mice(subj_dat, m=5, method='pmm', seed=808, printFlag=F)

completed_list <- mice::complete(imp_data, action='all')

# merge the completed datasets back into a main dataset list and filter baseline
subjData.imp <- lapply(completed_list,
                       function(df) {subjData |>
                           dplyr::select(-Age) |>
                           dplyr::left_join(df, by="ID")})

subjDataNoAmb.imp <- lapply(subjData.imp,
                            function(df) {df |>
                                dplyr::filter(UASLAeq != "Baseline") |>
                                droplevels()
                            } )

```

## rescaling variables

```{r}

# rescale variables

centre_vars <- c("UASLAeqMaxLR", "UASLAEMaxLR", "Age", "NoiseSensitivity")

out <- standardise_list(list(subjData, subjDataNoAmb, subjDataNoAmb.cc,
                             subjDataNoAmb.med),
                        vars = centre_vars,
                        scale = FALSE)

subjData <- out[[1]]
subjDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]
subjDataNoAmb.cc <- out[[3]]
subjDataNoAmb.med <- out[[4]]

centre_stim_vars <- c("UASLAeqMaxLR", "UASLAEMaxLR")

out <- standardise_list(list(stimData, stimDataNoAmb),
                        vars = centre_stim_vars,
                        scale = FALSE)

stimData <- out[[1]]
stimDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]


out <- standardise_list(list(subjData, subjDataNoAmb, subjDataNoAmb.cc, subjDataNoAmb.med),
                        vars = c("TrialNumber"),
                        scale = TRUE)

subjData <- out[[1]]
subjDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]
subjDataNoAmb.cc <- out[[3]]
subjDataNoAmb.med <- out[[4]]

# rescale trial number variables separately for each session part
subjData <- rbind(subjData[subjData$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                    dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjData[subjData$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                    dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()

subjDataNoAmb <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb[subjDataNoAmb$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                         dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjDataNoAmb[subjDataNoAmb$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                      dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()

subjDataNoAmb.cc <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb.cc[subjDataNoAmb.cc$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                            dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjDataNoAmb.cc[subjDataNoAmb.cc$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                      dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()

subjDataNoAmb.med <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb.med[subjDataNoAmb.med$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                             dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjDataNoAmb.med[subjDataNoAmb.med$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                      dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()



subjDataNoAmb.imp <- standardise_list(subjDataNoAmb.imp,
                                    vars = centre_vars,
                                    scale = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(subjDataNoAmb.imp)) {

  subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]] <- subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]] |>
    dplyr::mutate(TrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(TrialNumber, scale=TRUE))

  subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]] <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]][subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]]$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                             dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]][subjDataNoAmb.imp[[i]]$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                      dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()
}


```

# Annoyance

## mA1: maximal ordinal model for annoyance, median imputed

### Model A1 formula

```{R}

mA1_pop_level <- c("PartTrialNumberScl",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents))",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASType",
                   "UASOperation*UASType",
                   "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                   "AgeScl", "Sex", "NoiseSensitivityScl", "Area_soundscape2")

mA1_grp_level <- list(ID = c(),
                     StimID = c())

mA1formula <- build_bf(y = "AnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mA1_pop_level,
                       re = mA1_grp_level)


```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

emp_threshA1 <- round(qlogis(cumsum(prop.table(table(subjDataNoAmb$AnnoyanceOrd)))), 2)
# truncate emp_thresh to remove infinite values
emp_threshA1 <- emp_threshA1[is.finite(emp_threshA1)]

#     real log_abs_det_J = log(K) + logistic_lpdf(anchoredcutoffs | 0, 1);

priorsA1 <- c(
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class='b'),
  # brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class='b', coef=c('UASLAEMaxLRScl:Ilog10UASEvents',
  #                                                     'UASOperationLanding:UASTypeM300',
  #                                                     'UASOperationLanding:UASTypeT150',
  #                                                     'UASOperationTakeoff:UASTypeM300',
  #                                                     'UASOperationTakeoff:UASTypeT150',
  #                                                     'AmbientEnvStreet:UASOperationLanding',
  #                                                     'AmbientEnvStreet:UASOperationTakeoff',
  #                                                     'AmbientEnvStreet:UASTypeM300',
  #                                                     'AmbientEnvStreet:UASTypeT150',
  #                                                     'UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnvStreet')),
  # brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", class='b', coef=c('UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnvStreet:UASOperationLanding',
  #                                                     'UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnvStreet:UASOperationTakeoff',
  #                                                     'UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnvStreet:UASTypeM300',
  #                                                     'UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnvStreet:UASTypeT150')),
  # brms::set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 2.5)", class = "sd", group = "ID"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0),  # half-normal via lb=0
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 0.5), class='b', coef='PartTrialNumberScl'),
  # cumulative_intercept_prior(11, sd=5, shape='middle')
  brms::prior_string(paste0("normal(", emp_threshA1,", 10)"), class = "Intercept", coef = 1:length(emp_threshA1))

)

# extract the data for the model
mA1Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, all.vars(mA1formula$formula), drop=FALSE]

tic()
mA1Priors <- brms::brm(mA1formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 # stanvars = dirichlet_prior_stanvar,
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mA1_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mA1Priors, ndraws = 100)
mA1_ppd

mA1PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mA1Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")
mA1PriorCheck

tic()
mA1 <- brms::brm(mA1formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mA1 <- brms::add_criterion(mA1, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mA1$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA1, re_formula=NULL))
```

## mA2: reduced maximal ordinal model for annoyance, median imputed

### Model A2 formula

```{R}

mA2_pop_level <- setdiff(mA1_pop_level, c("UASOperation*UASType", "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASType"))
mA2_pop_level <- unique(c(mA2_pop_level, "UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType", "AmbientEnv*UASType"))

mA2_grp_level <- mA1_grp_level

mA2formula <- build_bf(y = "AnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mA2_pop_level,
                       re = mA2_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
mA2Priors <- brms::brm(mA2formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mA2_ppd

mA2PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mA2Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mA2PriorCheck

tic()
mA2 <- brms::brm(mA2formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mA2 <- brms::add_criterion(mA2, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mA2$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA2, re_formula=NA))
mA2$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA2, re_formula=NULL))
```

## mA4: further reduced maximal ordinal model for annoyance, median imputed

### Model A4 formula

```{R}

mA4_pop_level <- setdiff(mA3_pop_level, c("UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType"))
mA4_pop_level <- unique(c(mA4_pop_level, "UASType"))

mA4_grp_level <- mA3_grp_level

mA4formula <- build_bf(y = "AnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mA4_pop_level,
                       re = mA4_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
mA4Priors <- brms::brm(mA4formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mA4_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mA4Priors, ndraws = 100)
mA4_ppd

mA4PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mA4Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mA4PriorCheck

tic()
mA4 <- brms::brm(mA4formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mA4 <- brms::add_criterion(mA4, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mA4$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA4, re_formula=NA))
mA4$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA4, re_formula=NULL))

```

```{r}
brms::pp_check(mA4, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnv') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mA4, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASEvents') +

  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mA4, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASType') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mA4, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASOperation') +
```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mA5_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mA5) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mA5_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mA5_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))


if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABAnnoyMnExpMod_MaxSD_brmsCo"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=12, height=12,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=12, height=12, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

## mA7 add scale model

### Model A7 formula

```{R}

mA7_pop_level <- mA6_pop_level

mA7_grp_level <- mA6_grp_level

mA7_dpar_grp_level <- list(ID = c())

mA7formula <- build_bf(y = "AnnoyanceOrd",
                        fixed = mA7_pop_level,
                        re = mA7_grp_level,
                       dpars = list(disc = list(re = mA7_dpar_grp_level,
                                                intercept=FALSE)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsA7 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar='mu'),  # half-normal via lb=0
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 0.5), class='b', coef='PartTrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior_string(paste0("normal(", emp_threshA1,", 10)"), class = "Intercept", coef = 1:length(emp_threshA1), dpar='mu'),
  # discrimination model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "disc")
)


tic()
mA7Priors <- brms::brm(mA7formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA7, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mA7_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mA7Priors, ndraws = 100)

mA7PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mA7Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mA7_ppd

mA7PriorCheck
mA7PriorCheck

tic()
mA7 <- brms::brm(mA7formula,
                 data=mA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsA7, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mA7 <- brms::add_criterion(mA7, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mA7$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA7, re_formula=NA))
mA7$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mA7, re_formula=NULL))
```

## mA8 ordered beta model for annoyance

### model A8 formula

```{r}

mA8_pop_level <- mA7_pop_level

mA8_grp_level <- mA7_grp_level

mA8_dpar_grp_level <- mA7_dpar_grp_level

mA8formula <- build_bf(y = "AnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mA8_pop_level,
                        re = mA8_grp_level,
                       dpars = list(phi = list(re = mA8_dpar_grp_level)))

# extract the data for the model
mA8Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, all.vars(mA8formula$formula), drop=FALSE]

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

p0 <- mean(na.omit(mA8Data)$AnnoyanceOrdBetaScl == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
p1 <- mean(na.omit(mA8Data)$AnnoyanceOrdBetaScl == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

xi_center   <- qlogis(p0)              # solves plogis(xi) = p0 exactly
coi_center  <- qlogis(1 - p1)          # solves 1 - plogis(xi+kappa) = p1
kappa_center <- coi_center - xi_center  # must come out positive, given kappa's <lower=0> constraint

y_cont <- na.omit(mA8Data)$AnnoyanceOrdBetaScl
y_cont <- y_cont[y_cont > 0 & y_cont < 1]
m <- mean(y_cont); v <- stats::var(y_cont)
phi_center <- log((m * (1 - m)) / v - 1)

priorsA8 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar='mu'),  # half-normal via lb=0
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 0.5), class='b', coef='PartTrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 2.5)", class='Intercept', dpar='mu'),

  # precision model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),

  # cutpoints
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mA8Priors <- brms::brm(mA8formula,
                 data=mA8Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsA8, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mA8PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mA8Priors, type='dens_overlay', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.2),labels=seq(0, 10, by=2), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating")

mA8PriorCheck + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, 5))

tic()
mA8 <- brms::brm(mA8formula,
                 data=mA8Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsA8, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mA8 <- brms::add_criterion(mA8, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mA8$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mA8))
mA8$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mA8, re_formula=NA))
mA8$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mA8, re_formula=NULL))

```

```{r}

summary(mA8)

```

```{r}

  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.2),labels=seq(0, 10, by=2), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating")
mA8PostCheck

mA8PostCheckEnv <- brms::pp_check(mA8, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnv') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
```

### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
mA8DataFit <- insight::get_data(mA8)

set.seed(999)
mA8predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(mA8, na.omit(mA8DataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, 0, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMean - mA8predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=mA8predMeans,
                     measured_target='AnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='AnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(mA8predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$AnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 10, by=1), limits=c(0, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 10, by=1), limits=c(0, 10)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating (test)", y="Predicted mean annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABAnnoyMnExpMod_Cal_brmsOb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4.5, height=4.5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4.5, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mA8_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mA8) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mA8_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mA8_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))
```

```{r}
  mA8, within_vars = within_vars_all, between_vars = between_vars_all,
```

### analyse between-subjects contrasts

```{r}

# contrast analysis for between-subjects variables

contrast_vars <- c("Sex", "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                    "Area_soundscape2")

mA8_between_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(contrast_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    mA8, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v, comparison_type = "pairwise",
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed=999,
    transform = \(x) betaTransform(x, 0, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
  )
  res$variable <- v
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(contrast_vars)),
    # Create the text label string
    y_label = paste(variable, contrast, sep = ": "),
    
    # Reorder the y-axis labels using the underlying numeric levels of 'variable'
    y_label = fct_reorder(y_label, as.numeric(variable))
  )

slope_vars <- c("AgeScl", "NoiseSensitivityScl")

mA8_covariate_slopes <- purrr::map_dfr(slope_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_slopes_manual(
    mA8, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v,
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed=999,
    transform = \(x) betaTransform(x, 0, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
  )
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(slope_vars))
  )
```

```{r}

p_type <- ggplot(data=mA8_type_fixed_lae,
                           aes(x = contrast, y = estimate, colour=contrast)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 12)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = alpha("grey65", alpha=0.75)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), linewidth = 1, size = 0.8) +
  # Add text annotation next to estimate point
  geom_text(aes(label = paste("pd:",
                              ifelse(pd > 0.99, ">0.99",
                                     sprintf("%.2f",
                                             round(pd, digits = 2))))),
            nudge_x = 0.15,      # Shifts text slightly to the right of the point
            hjust = 0,           # Left-aligns text relative to the nudge position
            family = "serif", 
            size = 4, 
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", round(estimate, digits = 2))),
            nudge_x = -0.325,      # Shifts text slightly to the right of the point
            hjust = 0,           # Left-aligns text relative to the nudge position
            family = "serif", 
            size = 4, 
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("[%.2f,\n%.2f]", round(conf.low, digits = 2), round(conf.high, digits = 2))),
            nudge_x = -0.075,     # Kept on the left side alongside the estimate
            nudge_y = -0.125,    # Slightly offset downward so it sits underneath the estimate
            hjust = 1,
            family = "serif", 
            size = 4, 
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = mycolours) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.2, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Difference in"~bar(Delta*A)))
```

# Change in annoyance

## mdA1: maximal ordinal model for dAnnoyance, median imputed

### Model dA1 formula

```{R}

mdA1_pop_level <- c("PartTrialNumberScl",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents))",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation",
                   "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASType",
                   "UASOperation*UASType",
                   "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                   "AgeScl", "Sex", "NoiseSensitivityScl", "Area_soundscape2")

mdA1_grp_level_id <- c()

mdA1_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA1_grp_level_id,
                     StimID = c())

mdA1_dpar_grp_level <- list(ID = c())

mdA1formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mdA1_pop_level,
                       re = mdA1_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

emp_threshdA1 <- round(qlogis(cumsum(prop.table(table(subjDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceOrd)))), 2)
# truncate emp_thresh to remove infinite values
emp_threshdA1 <- emp_threshdA1[is.finite(emp_threshdA1)]

priorsdA1 <- c(
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class='b'),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0),  # half-normal via lb=0
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 0.5), class='b', coef='PartTrialNumberScl'),
  brms::prior_string(paste0("normal(", emp_threshdA1,", 16)"), class = "Intercept", coef = 1:length(emp_threshdA1))
)

# extract the data for the model
mdA1Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, all.vars(mdA1formula$formula), drop=FALSE]

tic()
mdA1Priors <- brms::brm(mdA1formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA1_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mdA1Priors, ndraws = 100)
mdA1_ppd

mdA1PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA1Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance category index (-7 to 10)")
mdA1PriorCheck

tic()
mdA1 <- brms::brm(mdA1formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA1 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA1, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA1$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA1, re_formula=NA))
mdA1$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA1, re_formula=NULL))

```

## mdA2: reduced maximal ordinal model for dAnnoyance, median imputed

### Model dA2 formula

```{R}

mdA2_pop_level <- setdiff(mdA1_pop_level, c("UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASType"))
mdA2_pop_level <- unique(c(mdA2_pop_level, "UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType", "AmbientEnv*UASType"))

mdA2_grp_level <- mdA1_grp_level

mdA2formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mdA2_pop_level,
                       re = mdA2_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
mdA2Priors <- brms::brm(mdA2formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA2_ppd

mdA2PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA2Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mdA2PriorCheck

tic()
mdA2 <- brms::brm(mdA2formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA2 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA2, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA2$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA2, re_formula=NA))
mdA2$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA2, re_formula=NULL))
```

## mdA4: further reduced maximal ordinal model for dAnnoyance, median imputed

### Model dA4 formula

```{R}

mdA4_pop_level <- setdiff(mdA2_pop_level, c("UASOperation*UASType"))
mdA4_pop_level <- unique(c(mdA4_pop_level, "UASType"))

mdA4_grp_level <- mdA3_grp_level

mdA4formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrd",
                       fixed = mdA4_pop_level,
                       re = mdA4_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
mdA4Priors <- brms::brm(mdA4formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA4_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mdA4Priors, ndraws = 100)
mdA4_ppd

mdA4PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA4Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mdA4PriorCheck

tic()
mdA4 <- brms::brm(mdA4formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA4 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA4, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA4$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA4, re_formula=NA))
mdA4$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA4, re_formula=NULL))

```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA5_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA5) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA5_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA5_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))


if (saveplots){
```

## mdA6 reduce group-level effects

### Model dA6 formula

```{R}

mdA6_pop_level <- mdA5_pop_level

mdA6_grp_level_id <- setdiff(mdA5_grp_level_id, c("UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation"))
mdA6_grp_level_id <- unique(c(mdA6_grp_level_id, "AmbientEnv*UASOperation", "UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASOperation"))

mdA6_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA6_grp_level_id,
                      StimID = c())

mdA6formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrd",
                        fixed = mdA6_pop_level,
                        re = mdA6_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
mdA6Priors <- brms::brm(mdA6formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA6_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mdA6Priors, ndraws = 100)
mdA6_ppd

mdA6PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA6Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mdA6PriorCheck

tic()
mdA6 <- brms::brm(mdA6formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA6 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA6, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA6$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA6, re_formula=NA))
mdA6$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA6, re_formula=NULL))

```

### summarise


```{r}
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance category index (-7 to 10)")

brms::pp_check(mdA6, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnv') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance category index (-7 to 10)")

brms::pp_check(mdA6, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASEvents') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance category index (-7 to 10)")

brms::pp_check(mdA6, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASType') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance category index (-7 to 10)")

brms::pp_check(mdA6, type='bars_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASOperation') +
```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA6_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA6) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA6_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA6_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))


if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnExpMod_RedSD_brmsCo"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=12, height=12,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=12, height=12, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

## mdA7 add scale model

### Model dA7 formula

```{R}

mdA7_pop_level <- mdA6_pop_level

mdA7_grp_level <- mdA6_grp_level

mdA7_dpar_grp_level <- list(ID = c())

mdA7formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrd",
                        fixed = mdA7_pop_level,
                        re = mdA7_grp_level,
                       dpars = list(disc = list(re = mdA7_dpar_grp_level,
                                                intercept=FALSE)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA7 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar='mu'),  # half-normal via lb=0
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 0.5), class='b', coef='PartTrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior_string(paste0("normal(", emp_threshdA1,", 16)"), class = "Intercept", coef = 1:length(emp_threshdA1)),
  # discrimination model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "disc")
)

tic()
mdA7Priors <- brms::brm(mdA7formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA7, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA7_ppd <- ppd_ridgeplot(mdA7Priors, ndraws = 100)
mdA7_ppd

mdA7PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA7Priors, type='bars', ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean annoyance rating category index")

mdA7PriorCheck

tic()
mdA7 <- brms::brm(mdA7formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=cumulative(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr',
                 prior=priorsdA7, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
                 seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA7 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA7, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA7$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_marginal <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA7, re_formula=NA))
mdA7$criteria$bayes_R2_MZ_conditional <- as.data.frame(bayes_R2_MZ(mdA7, re_formula=NULL))
```
